summary: One cohesive behavior: the section 14.3 visual identity (darkest palettes, lowest visibility, distinct particles and silhouettes) for the two deep bands plus the final zone, including the section 16 scale-reveal camera zoom for the select colossal encounters staged in exactly those bands - a small additive camera behavior on the same scenes, explicitly assigned by the ST-06 plan, not an independently shippable feature. Two named subsystems (strict subset of the parent's four); at most three changed responsibilities (band identity parameter sets in the MACRO_WORLD data seam documented in understanding.md, render-pipeline expression in src/render/ incl. section 15 flashlight, camera zoom and dressing of these bands' critical-path areas). Carries AC-art-palettes verbatim; sibling union covers all six parent criteria with the cross-band proof owned by WI-06d, which depends on this item. No own dependencies; inherits ST-04/ST-05 via the story so encounters are stable before dressing. Evidence is focused: per-band 1080p browser inspection with private fixtures and screenshots reported without names per section 70, Node test asserting at least two identity factors distinguish each deep band from its adjacent band, suite/build green, section 34 performance spot-check. Handoff is self-contained and its pointers check out (understanding.md five-band data seam, src/render/ present); boundaries against WI-06d (juice list, remaining areas, final proof), WI-06e (audio), and ST-04/ST-05 (encounter authoring) are explicit non-goals.
